_comment: Curated publish titles (YouTube title + thumbnail header) per course, keyed by course id. An override for the registry's in-app narrative course.title — the in-app title is narrative ('What dbt Is'), this one is search-facing. Read by gen-descriptions.mjs and thumb.mjs. Deliberately does NOT lead with 'dbt', so the composed headline reads '<title> · dbt' without stammering.
foundations: ELT, dbt Core & Your First Run
